verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents built-in AI features that take on specific tasks: generating a mock server from a natural-language prompt, OpenAPI definition, or URL, and suggesting commit messages. There is no evidence of a general-purpose assistant that can take arbitrary delegated tasks. The MCP client feature connects to external servers and is not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a general in-app assistant or agent for arbitrary tasks (e.g. building requests, writing tests, debugging), multi-step agentic execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Creates a mock server from a prompt, OpenAPI definition, or live URL response. Automatically scaffolds routes, responses, and configurations.
Auto-generate a mock server from a natural language prompt and one of the following input types: URL, OpenAPI, or JSON.
AI-assisted mock server generation, which transforms prompts or API definitions into mock APIs.
AI commit message suggestions, which help maintain clear and atomic commit histories.
